modalities.evidence: EEG recordings from pediatric subjects with intractable seizures

output.population: 22 pediatric subjects (5 males and 17 females) with intractable seizures, grouped into 23 cases
output.summary: Scalp EEG recordings from pediatric subjects with intractable seizures, monitored after withdrawal of anti-seizure medication to characterize seizures and assess candidacy for surgery. Grouped into 23 cases from 22 subjects.
